hand_hints.description: Optional hand centers; variable digit count is still inferred from geometry.

root_hint.description: Optional world-space root hint. Does not supply a species or a topology.

matrix.description: Preserves a static affine node exactly, including shear. Animated nodes use TRS.

species_label.description: Optional identity only. Geometry never requires a species label.

flexion_axis_world.description:
Authored world-space flexion axis for deformation probes. Geometry-only
candidates omit this rather than inventing an anatomical palm plane.

score.description: Heuristic score; not a calibrated probability.

source_form.description: Reviewed structural identity, e.g. human, cloven_hoof, six_limb_chain.

palm_landmarks.description: Index, middle and little finger bases define the palm frame.

ArticulationLimit.description:
A characterized joint frame. The hinge axis is in the parent frame;
twist is about the outgoing bone in the joint frame.

driver_chain_root.description:
Optional arm root: allow a bounded translation of the primary grip so
both hands remain reachable after retargeting to different proportions.

driver_offset.description:
Prop-root transform relative to the driving hand. If omitted, calibrate
from reference_clip/reference_time, or from the default node pose.

max_driver_rotation_rad.description: Optional common rigid-prop rotation budget during constrained two-hand IK.

max_joint_angular_speed_rad_s.description: Optional temporal bound on each solved arm joint's local rotation.

node.description: An existing rigid scene root or a weapon's existing driving bone.

orientation_weight.description: Squared meter-equivalent scale for orientation residuals during IK.

radii_m.description: Lateral and front/back radii. The smaller is used for the rounded cap.

chain_root.description:
Only this root and its descendants may be activated by this volume.
None makes it an obstacle; other explicit effectors may still move it.

cross_section.description: Optional elliptical cross section, transported with the start joint.

interval.description:
Fractions along the start/end joint line; modest extrapolation allows
a hip or shoulder volume to extend beyond the joint centers.

position.description: Omission locks to the first baked contact sample, recorded in the report.

joints.description: Ordered base-to-tip chain, including a nondeforming tip when available.

chain_root.description: Restricts solving to this chain so it cannot move the primary hand.

offset.description:
Desired wrist/fingertip frame in prop-local coordinates. If omitted,
capture it from the attachment's explicit reference pose.

HandCorrectiveObstacle.description: Explicit rigid capsule in an existing scene node's local coordinates.

allow_rotation_fallback.description:
If false, retain authored finger rotations and report surface failures.
Use this for grips, where opening a fist is not a valid repair.

max_edge_ratio.description: An edge may grow to reference_length * ratio + growth_m.

rebind_missing_digits.description:
Explicitly repartition existing digit-weighted surface if some named
chains have no independent weights. The wrist/digit region is repartitioned; body weights are preserved.

surface_repair.description: Optional fixed-pose skin optimization before the runtime pose guard.

max_angle_rad.description: A cone bound relative to the reference local rotation; not an anatomy prior.

joints.description: Empty means all animation channels. Otherwise exact, unique node names.

source.description: If omitted, use the target's own animation. Paths are relative to the recipe.

name.description: Unique name of the new scene root, used by Attachment::node.

oneOf.description: Keep the last held world transform after end; no gravity is simulated.
Resume the underlying animation after end; transitions are caller-authored.

align_reference_chains.description:
Optionally align mapped limb directions to the source default posture
before transferring motion. Bilateral hip/shoulder landmarks and named
finger roots define full axial/palm frames instead of leaving roll free.

alignment.description: A world rotation aligning source reference axes to target reference axes.

distribute_wrist_twist.description:
Put axial hand rotation on the forearm while preserving the world hand
pose. Requires uniquely mapped direct forearm/hand pairs.

joint_map.description: Target-name -> source-name overrides. Names must be unique.

interval.description: Rigid interval along the bone, followed by a smooth falloff on each side.

lateral_reference.description:
Two joints defining a lateral direction in this model's reference pose.
When supplied, fit lateral and front/back widths independently.

radius_m.description: Explicit radius, or estimate it from the actual weighted surface.

align_to_ground.description:
Explicit walking preview correction. Also lowers floating support to
the plane; leave disabled for jumping or deliberately airborne motion.

preserve_source_height.description:
After collision solving, keep the source frame's support height. This
allows a bounded lowering as well as raising, preserving airborne phases.

support_joints.description: Exact skin joint names defining the surface to protect from the plane.

body_clearance.description:
Geometry-fitted capsules and selected separation pairs. Independent of
species or fixed bone names; the caller supplies a characterized rig.

distribute_twist.description:
Exact child-joint names whose axial rotation is distributed to their
direct parent after all constraints. The child's world pose is kept.

hand_shapes.description: Target digit lengths plus a bound on new skin-edge elongation.

surface_floor.description: Explicit skin-region floor protection; raises the root only as needed.

geometry_hash.description: Hash of local position and triangle arrays, independent of skin weights.

binding_config.description:
The surface method requires an explicit fitted blueprint. It is useful for
layered garments/open meshes, but does not infer their anatomical attachment.

envelope_radii_m.description:
Optional capsule radii keyed by blueprint joint ID. A nearby hand should
not acquire a detached skirt simply because the garment is close to it.

surface_regions.description: Exact, geometry-checked regions from calibrated visual boxes or authoring.

binding_config.title: BindConfig

source_form.description: Reviewed structural identity, e.g. human, cloven_hoof, six_limb_chain.

landmark_joint_map.description:
Explicit anatomical correspondence; body-model joint names are not
assumed equivalent to the dressed source's skeleton vocabulary.

joint_deltas.description: Author-supplied joint-center movement for unit shape change, Y-up meters.

replace_plane.description:
Optional half-space gate, in the prior's reference coordinates.
Removes only the distal side of a wrist/neck, not a broad hand box.

replace_prior_min.description:
Replacement region in the prior's reference coordinates. The donor's
corresponding head/hand must not coexist with the observed source part.

source.description: Exact source surface; its positions, UV, normals and textures are copied.

source_clip.description:
Optional exact cut of the observed static surface, retaining the
negative half-space. Edge vertices and FLOAT attributes are interpolated.

source_translation_world.description:
Rigid placement after the original surface is cut, in world Y-up metres.
Local face/UV/normal data remain unchanged; zero preserves old behavior.

RadialParameter.description:
A positive local girth control on an explicitly mapped articulation segment.
The authored weights keep unrelated regions out of its deformation domain.

world_space.description: Cut in the fitted world surface instead of the unposed reference.

geometry_hash.description: Hash of local position and triangle arrays, independent of skin weights.

allow_incomplete_interfaces.description:
Diagnostic exports only. Normal builds reject any requested interface
which was not constructed successfully, before publishing a bundle.

skin_appearance_samples.description:
Representative source skin for diffuse/PBR estimation. Kept separate
from geometric constraints so a beard, collar seam or baked highlight
cannot dominate the inferred hidden body's material.

position_axes.description:
World axes constrained by this target. For grounded stance, X/Z may be
locked while the independently measured sole controls vertical height.

geometry_hash.description: Hash of local position and triangle arrays, independent of skin weights.

max_rounds.description: None lets the agent decide when to stop; each individual step is bounded.

surface_contacts.description: Optional additive gate, frozen after installation in an existing session.

oneOf.description: Couple render duplicates proven to share a manifold geometric seam.
Preserve reference-side ordering of triangles that cross in sampled poses.
Change only the optional round budget, with a persistent audit record.
Preserve the best numeric result while explicitly failing visual review.

geometry_hash.description: Hash of local position and triangle arrays, independent of skin weights.

contact_smoothing.description: Smooth corrections, not the original weights, across adjacent surface vertices.

contact_weight_change_l1.description: Additional L1 trust radius around the start of this surface-repair step.

continue_from_round.description: Continue a promising rejected candidate while retaining the current best.

expected_round.description: Must equal the number of completed correction rounds in session.json.

resume_after_review.description: Explicitly continue an unresolved review without resetting the ledger.

surface_contacts.description: Installs an additive surface-crossing gate; cannot relax an existing one.

max_orientation_deviation_rad.description:
Optional limit around the observed orientation transported with the
body anchor. A long raised hock must not inherit an unrestricted human
heel-strike roll. None retains the full FK orientation.

position_scale.description:
Scale the source end-point displacement around the observed target
reference offset. Defaults to the configured root-motion scale.

target_anchor.description:
A mapped body anchor, for example Hips. Source endpoints/anchor are
resolved from the verified mapping, not guessed from species names.

target_chain.description:
Root, middle, orientation joint, end joint. The first three form a
direct two-bone IK chain; the last segment retains its FK orientation.

align_reference_chains.description:
Optionally align mapped limb directions to the source default posture
before transferring motion. Bilateral hip/shoulder landmarks and named
finger roots define full axial/palm frames instead of leaving roll free.

alignment.description: A world rotation aligning source reference axes to target reference axes.

distribute_wrist_twist.description:
Put axial hand rotation on the forearm while preserving the world hand
pose. Requires uniquely mapped direct forearm/hand pairs.

joint_map.description: Target-name -> source-name overrides. Names must be unique.

limb_trajectories.description:
Optional end-point trajectory adaptation for reviewed limb chains with
different proportions. Timing still comes from the source clip.

preserve_reference_joints.description:
Explicit target joints whose reference world rotation must retain the
observed target posture while other chains are aligned. For example,
do not straighten a reviewed digitigrade leg into a human reference.
This does not infer anatomy or replace motion/contact validation.

matrix.description: Preserves a static affine node exactly, including shear. Animated nodes use TRS.

flexion_axis_world.description:
Authored world-space flexion axis for deformation probes. Geometry-only
candidates omit this rather than inventing an anatomical palm plane.

ArticulationLimit.description:
A characterized joint frame. The hinge axis is in the parent frame;
twist is about the outgoing bone in the joint frame.

radii_m.description: Lateral and front/back radii. The smaller is used for the rounded cap.

chain_root.description:
Only this root and its descendants may be activated by this volume.
None makes it an obstacle; other explicit effectors may still move it.

cross_section.description: Optional elliptical cross section, transported with the start joint.

interval.description:
Fractions along the start/end joint line; modest extrapolation allows
a hip or shoulder volume to extend beyond the joint centers.

max_angle_rad.description: A cone bound relative to the reference local rotation; not an anatomy prior.

source_form.description: Reviewed structural identity, e.g. human, cloven_hoof, six_limb_chain.

BindConfig.description:
The surface method requires an explicit fitted blueprint. It is useful for
layered garments/open meshes, but does not infer their anatomical attachment.

envelope_radii_m.description:
Optional capsule radii keyed by blueprint joint ID. A nearby hand should
not acquire a detached skirt simply because the garment is close to it.

surface_regions.description: Exact, geometry-checked regions from calibrated visual boxes or authoring.

garment_vertices.description: Explicitly painted garment observations override the color proposal.

skin_vertices.description: Explicit user/agent skin observations, in the exported primitive domain.

minimum_radial_fraction.description: Reject a section rather than flattening it below this fraction.

template_relax_iterations.description: Optional relaxation of a synthetic voxel prior; zero for an authored body.

template_weight_segments.description:
Authored template bone -> cage segment. Bound vertices without a mapped
influence stay unresolved instead of acquiring a spatially nearby bone.

max_displacement_m.description: World-space budget, including all iterations; units must already be metres.

matrix.description: Preserves a static affine node exactly, including shear. Animated nodes use TRS.

joint.description: Exact node ID or an unambiguous node name in the working skeleton.

RegionSeed.description: Exact source vertices, not positions on a different template or a previous output.

mesh.description: Index in asset_inspect's flattened mesh primitive list.

rules.description: Optional explicit spatial/appearance rules generate sparse source seeds.

flexion_axis_world.description:
Authored world-space flexion axis for deformation probes. Geometry-only
candidates omit this rather than inventing an anatomical palm plane.

geometry_hash.description: Hash of local position and triangle arrays, independent of skin weights.

WeightPatch.description:
A surface domain and Dirichlet anchors for constrained harmonic skin weights.
Only these bones may influence the domain. Disconnected unseeded islands fail.

blueprint.description: Optional fitted source-specific rig. Existing animations then need retargeting.

clothing_hints.description:
Source-space, confirmed humanoid landmarks for the interactive wardrobe.
Source skin samples and coherent surface interiors seed the partition.

completion.description: A standard body is a geometric prior, not a replacement for observed skin.

source_hash.description: Required whenever exact vertex hints are supplied. Prevents stale masks.

uv_mask_size.description: Zero disables UV masks. Values up to 2048 are supported.

geometry_hash.description: Hash of local position and triangle arrays, independent of skin weights.

xyxy.description: [xmin,ymin,xmax,ymax] normalized to [0,1]; origin at the image top-left.

provenance.description: Provider/model or inspecting agent identity, prompt version and evidence notes.
